note: Newest first. Add an entry at the top for every change visitors would notice. kind: New, Improved, Fixed or Removed. Dates are UTC (YYYY-MM-DD).

entries.title: Sleeve supports checked in Orca Slicer and ElegooSlicer
details: Sleeve clip exports were opened and sliced in the Orca Slicer and ElegooSlicer apps, including ElegooSlicer with its own Centauri Carbon printer profile selected. Neither warns that supports are off, and plate 1 slices with manual supports in both. Creality Print and Anycubic Slicer Next have not been checked in their apps.

entries.title: Snapmaker Orca no longer warns that supports are off for sleeve clips
details: Clips with a holder sleeve need manual supports. Snapmaker Orca swaps in its own print profile for the U1, which switched them off and showed support enforcers are used but support is not enabled. Each sleeve clip now carries its own Normal (manual) support setting, so supports stay on. Checked with the Snapmaker U1 profile in Snapmaker Orca 2.4.0. The same setting is written for Orca Slicer, Creality Print, ElegooSlicer and Anycubic Slicer Next, which are not yet checked.

entries.title: Snapmaker printers and Snapmaker Orca
details: The printer list now includes Snapmaker (A150, A250, A350, J1 / J1s, U1 and Artisan, grouped by bed size), and Snapmaker Orca is one of the slicers you can export for. The Snapmaker U1 export has been opened and sliced in Snapmaker Orca; tell us if a file does not open in another Snapmaker model.

entries.title: Homepage no longer says the file is only for Bambu Studio
details: The tag under the headline now reads One 3MF for your favorite slicer, and the studio and guide pages now say your slicer instead of Bambu Studio, since the studio also writes projects for Orca Slicer, Creality Print, ElegooSlicer, Anycubic Slicer Next and PrusaSlicer.

entries.title: Creality, Elegoo, Anycubic and Prusa printers, and Orca Slicer
details: The printer list is now grouped by brand and bed size instead of listing every model, so one choice covers all the models that share a bed. Bambu Lab, Creality, Elegoo, Anycubic and Prusa are included.

A new Open the project in choice writes the 3MF the way each slicer reads it: Bambu Studio, Orca Slicer, Creality Print, ElegooSlicer, Anycubic Slicer Next or PrusaSlicer. Orca Slicer works with any printer, including Bambu Lab.

Printers without a multi-color system (the default for non-Bambu brands) get the engraved style, so each plate prints in one filament. Turn on Multi-color system for a Creality CFS, Elegoo Canvas, Anycubic ACE or Prusa MMU.

Tested by slicing real exports in Bambu Studio, Orca Slicer, ElegooSlicer and PrusaSlicer. Creality Print and Anycubic Slicer Next read the same format as Orca Slicer, but their command-line tools could not be used to check it, so please tell us if either does not open a file correctly.

entries.title: Clips generated counter
details: The home page now shows how many clips and holders have been generated so far. The count is anonymous: only the number of labels and holders in each batch is counted, never the label text, and no IP addresses are stored.

entries.title: New blue look
details: The site and studio now use the blue Clip Studio color scheme instead of green, to match the Clip Studio logo.

entries.title: NFC tag pockets
details: Turn on NFC tag pockets in Style the batch to add a shallow 0.5 mm recess for a round NFC sticker (25 mm NTAG213 by default, 0.4 mm clearance). Stick the tag in and your phone or inventory app can read the clip or holder.

Clips with a holder sleeve get the pocket centered on the back of the sleeve. Clips without a sleeve get it on the back beside the tunnel; on Cookiecad and Amolen clips the pocket is trimmed flat there, so trim the sticker to match. We recommend the holder sleeve version, which is neater.
Holders get a pocket on the underside, under each post, so you can tap your phone on the front of the holder.

entries.title: Shorter names that print in full
details: Long Bambu Lab, Cookiecad and Amolen type and color names are shortened so no label gets cut off. Examples: PLA Translucent is now PLA Clear, Iridium Gold Metallic is Iridium Gold, Funfetti Clear with Rainbow Glitter is Funfetti, and Amolen PLA Temp Color Change is PLA Thermo.
CSVs and spreadsheet rows that use the old names still import into the studio. Saved batches are not affected.

entries.title: Cookiecad Lavender/Purple
details: Batches that included the Cookiecad PLA color Lavender/Purple failed at Review labels because its old name contained a backslash. It is renamed Lavender/Purple and works again.

entries.title: Label style photo
details: The studio and the guide now show one label printed three ways, with the settings behind each: an inlay on a filament-colored body, an inlay on a black body, and engraved text.

entries.title: Jayo spools
details: Added 302 Jayo colors across 25 filament types: the 1.1 kg rolls on Jayo's reusable plastic spool from the US Jayo store, including sold-out colors (Jayo ABS comes in 1 kg).
Jayo reusable spools use the Bambu Lab clip.
The Google Sheets batch builder offers Jayo too.
Cardboard-spool and transparent-spool rolls, 5 kg spools, bundles and multi-roll packs aren't included.

entries.title: Change log
details: This page: a dated list of what changed on the site and in the studio.

entries.title: Sunlu spools
details: Added 410 Sunlu 1 kg rolls across 50 filament types, taken from the US Sunlu store, including sold-out colors.
Sunlu 1 kg spools use the Bambu Lab clip.
The Google Sheets batch builder offers Sunlu too.
Refill coils, 3 kg and 5 kg spools, 250 g minis and 0.8–0.9 kg rolls aren't included.

entries.title: Filament-modifier label style
details: The "Flat color · filament modifiers" style didn't print well and has been removed. Choose Flat colored inlay or Engraved.
Saved batches that used it now open on Flat colored inlay.

entries.title: Amolen clips
details: Amolen clips can be generated again; batches with Amolen spools were failing.
Updated Amolen clip geometry, with and without the holder sleeve: corrected front and back orientation, and a cleaner, watertight model.

entries.title: Holder sleeve turns on automatically
details: Entering any AMS or dryer count now switches on the holder sleeve, the collar that secures a clip in its holder. You can still turn it off.
The studio, guide, holders page and front page explain what the sleeve does.

entries.title: Split four-post holder
details: A four-post holder in two halves joined by a dovetail, for printers that can't fit the 320 mm one-piece holder.
The studio uses it automatically on those printers, so every printer in the studio can now make AMS 2 Pro holders.

entries.title: Front page and filamentclip.com
details: The site moved to filamentclip.com. Old github.io links forward to it.
A new front page explains the site and lists the supported spools. The studio moved to /studio.
Request a fit for a spool brand that isn't supported yet with the new spool request form.

entries.title: Holders and mounting templates
details: One-, two- and four-post holders, plus mounting templates for the Bambu Lab AMS 2 Pro and AMS HT and the Creality SpacePi X4.
In the studio, enter how many of each device you have. The batch then includes the holders and templates they need.
The new holders page has downloads, renders, photos and step-by-step mounting for each device.

entries.title: Paste rows and Google Sheets batch builder
details: Paste rows straight from a spreadsheet into the studio.
A Google Sheets batch builder, with dropdowns for manufacturer, type and color, replaces the Excel workbook. It reads the studio's own catalog, so the two stay in sync.

entries.title: Support Clip Studio
details: Added an optional Ko-fi support link and a way to offer development hardware.

entries.title: Amolen spools
details: Added Amolen 1 kg spools with their own tested clip fit, with and without the holder sleeve.

entries.title: Holder sleeve printing
details: Refined sleeve support settings so supports stay out of the tunnel and off its entrance.
The studio now shows which build is running.

entries.title: User guide
details: Published the user guide, with how-to steps for building, importing and printing a batch.

entries.title: Owner-tested sleeved clips
details: Sleeved clips now use the physically tested design, with support blockers included in the project.

entries.title: Holder sleeves
details: Added the holder sleeve option.
Clips are exported standing on their side for cleaner label text.

entries.title: Filament Clip Studio beta
details: First public release. Build a batch of Bambu Lab and Cookiecad label clips in your browser and download one multi-plate 3MF.
